title: Balancing Construction 1 AOFVS maps by EA transformations
summary: Determine whether every vectorial AOFVS map from Construction 1 admits an extended-affine transformation to a balanced map.

formal_statement.body: For every integer $k\ge2$, set $s=k+2$ and $n=s+k=2k+2$. For every admissible vectorial AOFVS map $H:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^s$ generated by Construction 1, determine whether there exists an extended-affine transformation $T_H$, allowed to depend on $H$, such that $T_H(H)$ is balanced.

scope.domain: Vectorial AOFVS functions, balancedness, and extended-affine transformations
assumptions: H is an admissible member of the source's Construction 1
AOFVS and balanced vectorial maps use the source definitions
The EA transformation may depend on the Construction 1 member H
scope.unresolved_remainder: For every k >= 2 and every admissible Construction 1 member H, construct an EA transformation T_H making T_H(H) balanced, or prove that no such transformation exists for some member.

progress.summary: The source asks whether every Construction 1 AOFVS map can be transformed into a balanced map by a suitable EA transformation.
